summary: Knight-Swift Transportation Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, announcing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable September 21, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 4, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies, as the filing is an ordinary current report regarding a standard capital return to shareholders.
